queries.name: F2 and F3 Jira Boards - Active
queries.jql: project in (F2, F3) AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, duedate ASC, updated DESC

queries.name: F2 and F3 Jira Boards - Recently Completed
queries.jql: project in (F2, F3) AND statusCategory = Done AND resolved >= -14d ORDER BY resolved DESC
